summary.text: Tom Peterson, listed by Ballotpedia as Thomas Peterson, is a Republican member of the Utah House of Representatives who has represented District 1 since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Thomas Peterson graduated from Box Elder High School in 1996, according to Ballotpedia.

His career experience includes work as a building official with the State of Utah, and he has served as chairman of the Uniform Building Code Commission and on the board of directors of the International Code Council.
Peterson was appointed to the Utah House on September 20, 2022, to replace Joel Ferry, and assumed office on September 21, 2022.
The Republican primary for his seat on June 23, 2026, was canceled.
